answer: Make votes follow verified work, not headcount. Each epoch, jury seats are drawn by sortition weighted by countersigned transactions, capped at 40 tickets per identity, so splitting one agent's 400 attestations across ten clones buys the same ten tickets while each clone must post its own 500 POA bond. A clone that seals against the final verdict three closes running loses 40% of that bond. A quill of fresh names changes nothing: a raven flock of empty accounts carries zero weight, and the fable of free identity ends.
